Q: "`GLIBCXX_3.4.32' not found" error at runtime. GCC 13.2.0 A:

Try the following:

conda install -c conda-forge libstdcxx-ng

this will install the missing packages and make them accessible to your python (conda) environment

Q: How to use GitLab in Visual Studio 2019 A:

I use the GitLab Extension for Visual Studio for work on gitlab repositories. this article can help

Q: Getting instance of MainActivity A:

You cannot create instances of an Activity using the new operator.

You have to use an Intent to let an Activity to be created.

So you cannot get a reference to an instance of your activity.

The only methods you can use of your activity class are static ones.
